title: Polish eve approval window empty state
summary: Updated the macOS approval utility so the attention popup closes when the review queue empties after resolving pending plans, the menu bar empty state uses a compact window size, and visible product copy uses lowercase eve branding.
userVisibleChange: After approving or rejecting the final displayed plan request, the popup no longer stays open on an empty state. Opening the menu bar app with no displayed requests now shows a smaller empty window, and app copy consistently says eve.

timeline.title: Declared locked plan
timeline.summary: Locked plan_bfac39234ccb7eb5 revision 1 before editing macOS approval files.

timeline.title: Added queue-drain close and compact sizing
timeline.summary: PlanQueueStore now notifies the AppKit attention panel when a previously pending review queue becomes empty, and the menu bar window picks a compact size when no requests are displayed.

timeline.title: Verified Swift and Xcode targets
timeline.summary: Ran Swift package tests, Xcode macOS tests, Release build, and whitespace checks.

timeline.title: Applied code-review cleanup
timeline.summary: Clarified the queue-drain helper naming and removed a duplicated size lookup; intentionally kept stale requests visible.

decisions.title: Keep stale requests visible
decisions.rationale: The popup closes only when the displayed review queue is empty. Stale requests still carry actionable stale-reason context, so they remain visible instead of being hidden by the pending-count transition.

decisions.title: Compact only the empty menu bar window
decisions.rationale: The full-size queue remains for one or more displayed requests so multiple waiting plans and stale review items keep their sidebar/detail layout.
